name: Queue-first application approval
prompt: A high-fidelity desktop CRM composition for The Clean Crew in the established Trust Blue system. Persistent job header and crew progress frame a queue-first Applications review workspace. Awaiting applicants lead; the selected applicant reveals an open-slot choice, explicit immediate-assignment reassurance, one primary Approve for slot action, and secondary Not selected. Resolved responses stay available below. Direct non-applicant staffing remains visibly separate. Calm operational hierarchy, accessible controls, no invented applicant scoring or free-text rejection reason.
